## Notes

Release candidate of baseline glTF 2.0 splat extension; compression proposals SPZ (Niantic Spatial) and L-GSC (Qualcomm); contributors Autodesk, Cesium/Bentley, Esri, Huawei, Niantic Spatial, NVIDIA, XGRIDS; ratification expected Q2 2026.
